map.Goodman 居中、最常用；Gerber 对韧性材料更接近试验但偏乐观；Sod: Goodman sits in the middle and is most common; Gerber is closer to test data for ductile materials but optimistic; Soderberg uses yield strength as the criterion and is most conservative. For safety-critical parts, also look at the Soderberg result and take the lower bound.
map.b 和 σf' 怎么取？: How are b and σf' chosen?
map.b 为疲劳强度指数，钢材常取 −0.085~−0.12；σf' 为疲劳强度系数，: b is the fatigue strength exponent, usually −0.085 to −0.12 for steel; σf' is the fatigue strength coefficient, approximated as 1.0 to 1.2 times tensile strength. Both are best obtained by regressing the material S-N curve, and handbook values are only a first estimate.
